# n8n: Workflow Automation Platform Analysis

Citation-backed research on n8n — what it is, how it compares to alternatives,
and how it fits into agentic AI orchestration workflows.

## TL;DR

n8n is a visual workflow automation platform (TypeScript/Node.js) that uniquely
combines drag-and-drop design with custom code and 70+ LangChain-integrated AI
nodes. Self-hostable with a free Community Edition. Reached $2.5B valuation in
October 2025. Best positioned for teams that need AI agent orchestration with
visual workflows, self-hosting, and cost efficiency — but not suitable for
mission-critical transactional workflows (use Temporal) or non-technical teams
wanting zero DevOps (use Zapier).

## Quick Comparison

| Feature | n8n | Zapier | Make | Temporal | Windmill |
|---------|-----|--------|------|----------|----------|
| Self-hosting | Yes (free) | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| AI/LLM nodes | 70+ | Limited | New (2025) | Preview | No |
| Pricing model | Per workflow | Per step | Per operation | Per namespace | N/A |
| Cloud entry | $24/mo | $19.99/mo | Per-op | $100/mo | N/A |
| Interface | Visual + code | Visual | Visual | Code-only | Code-first |
| License | Fair-code | Proprietary | Proprietary | MIT | AGPLv3 |

## Decision Framework

1. **Need self-hosting?** → n8n (free), Temporal, Windmill, or Airflow
2. **AI/agent orchestration?** → n8n is the most AI-native option
3. **Team skill level?** → Non-technical: Zapier/Make. Mixed: n8n. Engineers:
   Temporal/Windmill
4. **Mission-critical reliability?** → Temporal (durable execution, auto recovery)
5. **Budget-sensitive?** → Self-hosted n8n ($5-10/month infrastructure)
